@@ -176,0 +176,14 @@ + *

+ * The returned {@code DrawingContext} is currently implemented by the software renderer, + * which does not support all optional features of {@code DrawingContext}: + *

    + *
  • effects; + *
  • path based clipping; + *
  • clipping under a transform containing rotation or shear; + *
  • blend modes other than {@link javafx.scene.effect.BlendMode#SRC_OVER SRC_OVER}. + *
+ * Fractional clip rectangles are rounded inward to the image's pixel grid + * (with the identity transform, clip coordinates are image pixels), so a clip + * covering less than one pixel may become empty. + * These are limitations of the current implementation and are not part of the + * {@code DrawingContext} contract; they may be lifted in a future release.
